```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  setup-python:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
          cache: 'true'

  tests:
    needs: setup-python
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name: Run tests
        run: pytest

  coverage:
    needs: tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          file: ./coverage.xml
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella
          fail_ci_if_error: true

  generate-badge:
    needs: coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Generate coverage badge
        run: |
          curl -L https://img.shields.io/codecov/c/github/${{ github.repository }}?token=${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }} -o .github/badges/coverage.svg
      - name: Commit badge to repository
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v4
        with:
          commit_message: "chore: Add coverage badge"
          add_options: ".github/badges/coverage.svg"
          commit_user_name: "GitHub Actions"
          commit_user_email: "actions@github.com"

  release-testing-python38:
    needs: setup-python
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.8']
    steps:
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name: Run tests
        run: pytest

  release-testing-python39:
    needs: setup-python
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.9']
    steps:
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name: Run tests
        run: pytest

  release-testing-python310:
    needs: setup-python
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.10']
    steps:
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name: Run tests
        run: pytest
```
